theorem quantization_rigidity_of_no_arithmetic_frequency {ι : Type} [Countable ι]
    {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) {p : ι → ℂ} {ω : ι → ℝ}
    (hp : Summable fun j => ‖p j‖ * Real.exp (|ω j| / 2))
    (hphase : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x →
      cexp (((2 * Real.pi * quantizationResidualCumulative hW x : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) =
        ∑' j, p j * cexp (((ω j * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * I))
    (hno : ¬∃ j : ι, ∃ m n : ℕ, p j ≠ 0 ∧ 1 ≤ m ∧ 1 ≤ n ∧ m ≠ n ∧

    (∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → lam n = ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n) ∧ RiemannHypothesis

by
  classical
  let c : ℂ := ∑' j, if ω j = 0 then p j else 0
  have hsum (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
      (∑' j, p j * quantizationFrequencyResidue lam (ω j) m) =
        c * dirichletExp (lamLog lam) m := by
    rw [show c * dirichletExp (lamLog lam) m =
      ∑' j, (if ω j = 0 then p j else 0) * dirichletExp (lamLog lam) m from
        tsum_mul_right.symm]
    apply tsum_congr
    intro j
    by_cases hpj : p j = 0
    · simp [hpj]
    by_cases hω : ω j = 0
    · simp [hω, quantizationFrequencyResidue_zero hm]
    have hnone : ¬∃ n, quantizationFrequencyResonates (ω j) m n := by
      rintro ⟨n, hn, he⟩
      have hmn : m ≠ n := by
        intro h
        subst m
        exact hω (by linarith)
      apply hno ⟨j, m, n, hpj, hm, hn, hmn, ?_⟩
      rw [Real.log_div (by exact_mod_cast (show m ≠ 0 by omega))
        (by exact_mod_cast (show n ≠ 0 by omega))]
      linarith
    simp only [quantizationFrequencyResidue, dif_neg hnone, if_neg hω, mul_zero, zero_mul]
  obtain ⟨hne, hrows⟩ := quantization_phase_resonance_constant hW hp hphase
  rw [hsum 1 le_rfl, dirichletExp_one (lamLog_zero lam) (lamLog_one lam), mul_one] at hne hrows
  have hone (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≠ 0) : dirichletExp (lamLog lam) m = 1 := by
    have he := hrows m (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hm)
    rw [hsum m (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hm)] at he
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ hne (he.trans (mul_one c).symm)
  exact vonMangoldt_and_RH_of_coeff_eq_one
    (fun σ hσ => WeilMeanSquare.summable_abs_div_rpow_of_weilPositiveFull hW (σ := σ) hσ)
    (differentiableOn_weilContinuation hW) (fun _ hs => quantizationContinuation_eq_arch hW hs)

  have ha : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => ((s : ℂ) - 1) *

      (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 ((r : ℂ) * B)) := by

    rw [hfg]
    field_simp [hn]

    intro t

  rw [integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae (Eventually.of_forall hre0)

private theorem source_rigidity_or_phase_disorder_two_mul {lam : ℕ → ℝ}

  rcases source_rigidity_or_block_disorder hW (-θ) with hR | ⟨η, hη, hlarge⟩

      hum.norm.aestronglyMeasurable (Eventually.of_forall fun t => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)]

  have hAE : ∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Ioc T (2 * T)),

    apply (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioc).mpr
    filter_upwards [norm_lowerSourceRemainder_phase_ae hW (-θ)] with t ht hmem

  have hrI : IntegrableOn (fun t => ‖lowerSourceRemainder hW (-θ) (-t)‖) (Ioc T (2 * T)) := by
    refine (huI.const_mul (Real.exp 4 * Real.exp q)).mono' hrm.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    filter_upwards [hAE] with t ht
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)] using ht
  have hmono := setIntegral_mono_ae_restrict hrI (huI.const_mul (Real.exp 4 * Real.exp q)) hAE

/-!
# Rigidity for every weighted real-periodic canonical Weil phase

The rational-exponent subgroup reduces an arbitrary real base to a rational
base. Integer and signed noninteger rational rigidity then cover every case.
The final source-only alternative does not assert existence of a representation.
-/

open Complex Set Filter MeasureTheory
open scoped Topology
noncomputable section
namespace RHTower.WeilSpectral

/-- Reduced rational bases unify the integer and noninteger receivers. -/
theorem quantization_rigidity_of_rat_periodic_phase {lam : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) {q : ℚ} (hq : 1 < (q : ℝ)) {p : ℤ → ℂ}
    (hp : Summable fun k => ‖p k‖ * Real.exp (|2 * (k : ℝ) * Real.log (q : ℝ)| / 2))
    (hphase : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t →
      cexp (((2 * Real.pi * quantizationResidualCumulative hW t : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) =
        ∑' k : ℤ, p k * cexp (((2 * (k : ℝ) * Real.log (q : ℝ) * t : ℝ) : ℂ) * I)) :
    (∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → lam n = ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n) ∧ RiemannHypothesis := by
  have hq0 : (0 : ℚ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ q by linarith)
  have hnum : (q.num.natAbs : ℝ) = (q.num : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [Int.cast_natCast] using congrArg (fun z : ℤ => (z : ℝ))
      (Int.natAbs_of_nonneg (Rat.num_nonneg.mpr hq0))
  have hcast : (q.num.natAbs : ℝ) / q.den = q := by rw [hnum, ← Rat.cast_def]
  have hd : (0 : ℝ) < q.den := by exact_mod_cast q.den_pos
  have hdu : q.den < q.num.natAbs := by
    have hh : (1 : ℝ) < (q.num.natAbs : ℝ) / q.den := by rwa [hcast]
    have hh' := (lt_div_iff₀ hd).mp hh
    simpa only [one_mul, Nat.cast_lt] using hh'
  by_cases hv : q.den = 1
  · have hu : 2 ≤ q.num.natAbs := by omega
    have he : (q.num.natAbs : ℝ) = q := by simpa only [hv, Nat.cast_one, div_one] using hcast
    rw [← he] at hp hphase
    apply quantization_rigidity_of_periodic_phase hW hu ?_ hphase
    simpa only [quantization_qfrequency_weight hu] using hp
  · apply quantization_rigidity_of_bilateral_rational_phase hW (by have := q.den_pos; omega)
      hdu q.reduced
    · simpa only [hcast] using hp
    · simpa only [hcast] using hphase

/-- Every weighted periodic representation of the actual phase is rigid,
with no arithmetic restriction on the real base. -/
theorem quantization_rigidity_of_real_periodic_phase {lam : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) {r : ℝ} (hr : 1 < r) {p : ℤ → ℂ}
    (hp : Summable fun k => ‖p k‖ * Real.exp (|2 * (k : ℝ) * Real.log r| / 2))
    (hphase : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t →
      cexp (((2 * Real.pi * quantizationResidualCumulative hW t : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) =
        ∑' k : ℤ, p k * cexp (((2 * (k : ℝ) * Real.log r * t : ℝ) : ℂ) * I)) :
    (∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → lam n = ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n) ∧ RiemannHypothesis := by
  rcases quantization_rigidity_or_rational_period_power hW with hR | hpower
  · exact hR
  rcases quantization_rigidity_or_rational_harmonics hW with hR | hrat
  · exact hR
  obtain ⟨N, m, n, hN, _, _, he⟩ := hpower r hr p hp hphase
  have he' : r ^ N = ((m : ℚ) / n : ℚ) := by simpa only [Rat.cast_div, Rat.cast_natCast] using he
  obtain ⟨a, ha, ⟨q, hq⟩, hgen⟩ :=
    quantization_rational_exponent_generator (by omega : 0 < N) he' (by linarith : 0 < r)
  have hq1 : 1 < (q : ℝ) := by
    rw [hq, Real.one_lt_exp_iff]
    exact mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast ha) (Real.log_pos hr)
  obtain ⟨hp', hseries⟩ := quantization_periodic_reindex ha hq hp
    (fun k hk => (hgen k).mp (hrat r hr p hp hphase k hk))
  exact quantization_rigidity_of_rat_periodic_phase hW hq1 hp'
    (fun t ht => (hphase t ht).trans (hseries t))

/-- Source-only alternative: nonrigidity excludes every weighted real-periodic phase. -/
theorem quantization_rigidity_or_no_real_periodic_phase {lam : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    ((∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → lam n = ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n) ∧ RiemannHypothesis) ∨
      ∀ r : ℝ, 1 < r → ∀ p : ℤ → ℂ,
        (Summable fun k => ‖p k‖ * Real.exp (|2 * (k : ℝ) * Real.log r| / 2)) →
        ¬(∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t →
          cexp (((2 * Real.pi * quantizationResidualCumulative hW t : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) =
            ∑' k : ℤ, p k * cexp (((2 * (k : ℝ) * Real.log r * t : ℝ) : ℂ) * I)) := by
  classical
  by_cases hR : (∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → lam n = ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n) ∧ RiemannHypothesis
  · exact Or.inl hR
  · exact Or.inr fun r hr p hp hphase =>
      hR (quantization_rigidity_of_real_periodic_phase hW hr hp hphase)

/-- Positive dilation of the exact Hamburger kernel. -/
theorem quantization_offKernel_real_scale {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    {τ : ℂ} (hτ : τ ≠ 0) (s : ℂ) :
    offKernel ((x : ℂ) * τ) s =
      cexp ((Real.log x : ℂ) * (s - 1)) * offKernel τ s := by
  have hz : (Real.pi : ℂ) * τ ^ 2 ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr Real.pi_ne_zero) (pow_ne_zero _ hτ)
  have hx2 : (0 : ℝ) < x ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hx
  have hx2c : ((x ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hx2.ne'
  have he : (Real.pi : ℂ) * ((x : ℂ) * τ) ^ 2 =
      ((x ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((Real.pi : ℂ) * τ ^ 2) := by push_cast; ring
  have hc : (((x ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((Real.pi : ℂ) * τ ^ 2)) ^ (s / 2 - 1) =
      cexp ((2 * (Real.log x : ℂ)) * (s / 2 - 1)) *
        ((Real.pi : ℂ) * τ ^ 2) ^ (s / 2 - 1) := by
    rw [Complex.cpow_def_of_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hx2c hz),
      Complex.log_ofReal_mul hx2 hz,
      Real.log_pow, Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_natCast,
      add_mul, Complex.exp_add, ← Complex.cpow_def_of_ne_zero hz]
    norm_num
  have hxexp : (x : ℂ) = cexp (Real.log x : ℂ) := by
    rw [← Complex.ofReal_exp, Real.exp_log hx]
  have hexp : (x : ℂ) * cexp ((2 * (Real.log x : ℂ)) * (s / 2 - 1)) =
      cexp ((Real.log x : ℂ) * (s - 1)) := by
    rw [hxexp, ← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  unfold offKernel
  rw [he, hc]
  calc _ = ((x : ℂ) * cexp ((2 * (Real.log x : ℂ)) * (s / 2 - 1))) *
      ((Real.pi : ℂ) ^ (1 - s / 2) * τ *
        ((Real.pi : ℂ) * τ ^ 2) ^ (s / 2 - 1) / Complex.sin (Real.pi * s / 2)) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hexp]

/-- On the critical line, dilation is a unitary frequency shift and a scalar. -/
theorem quantization_pairKernel_real_scale {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    {τ : ℂ} (hτ : τ ≠ 0) (y : ℝ) :
    pairKernel y ((x : ℂ) * τ) =
      (Real.exp (-(Real.log x / 2)) : ℂ) *
        linTwist (-2 * Real.log x) (((1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + y * I) * pairKernel y τ := by
  rw [pairKernel_eq_offKernel, quantization_offKernel_real_scale hx hτ,
    pairKernel_eq_offKernel]
  congr 1
  unfold linTwist HamburgerStability.linePt
  rw [Complex.ofReal_exp, ← Complex.exp_add]
  congr 1
  push_cast
  ring

/-- The weighted frequency moment is stable under a fixed translation. -/
theorem summable_quantization_shifted_frequencies {ι : Type} {p : ι → ℂ} {ω : ι → ℝ}
    (hp : Summable fun j => ‖p j‖ * Real.exp (|ω j| / 2)) (a : ℝ) :
    Summable fun j => ‖p j‖ * Real.exp (|ω j - 2 * a| / 2) := by
  refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun j => by positivity) (fun j => ?_)
    (hp.mul_left (Real.exp |a|))
  calc ‖p j‖ * Real.exp (|ω j - 2 * a| / 2) ≤
      ‖p j‖ * Real.exp (|ω j| / 2 + |a|) := by
        gcongr
        have h := abs_sub (ω j) (2 * a)
        rw [abs_mul, abs_two] at h
        linarith
    _ = Real.exp |a| * (‖p j‖ * Real.exp (|ω j| / 2)) := by
      rw [Real.exp_add]
      ring

/-- Positive dilation preserves the right radial filter. -/
theorem quantization_tendsto_div_nhdsGT {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => ε / x) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝[>] 0) := by

  · exact eventually_nhdsWithin_of_forall fun ε hε => div_pos hε hx



/-- Fixed translation of the frequency parameter is multiplicative. -/
theorem quantization_linTwist_add (ω η : ℝ) (s : ℂ) :
    linTwist ω s * linTwist η s = linTwist (ω + η) s := by
  unfold linTwist
  rw [← Complex.exp_add]
  congr 1
  push_cast
  ring

/-- Real-height coefficient sum, normalized to the height-one kernel. -/
def quantizationRealFrequencySum {ι : Type} (lam : ℕ → ℝ) (p : ι → ℂ)
    (ω : ι → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  (Real.exp (Real.log x / 2) : ℂ) *
    ∑' j, p j * quantizationFrequencyResidue lam (ω j - 2 * Real.log x) 1

/-- Dilation of the complete lower-tail integral is an exact frequency shift. -/
theorem quantization_frequency_integral_real_scale {ι : Type} (p : ι → ℂ) (ω : ι → ℝ)
    (F : ℝ → ℂ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) {τ : ℂ} (hτ : τ ≠ 0) :
    (∫ y in Iic (-2 : ℝ), (∑' j, p j * linTwist (ω j) (((1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + y * I)) *
      (F y * pairKernel y ((x : ℂ) * τ))) =
    (Real.exp (-(Real.log x / 2)) : ℂ) *
      ∫ y in Iic (-2 : ℝ), (∑' j, p j * linTwist (ω j - 2 * Real.log x)
        (((1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + y * I)) * (F y * pairKernel y τ) := by
  rw [← integral_const_mul]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  exact Eventually.of_forall fun y => by
    dsimp only

private theorem centered_energy_identity (a : ℕ → ℂ) (B : ℂ) (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ‖a n - B‖ ^ 2 / n) / Real.log N =
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ‖a n‖ ^ 2 / n) / Real.log N -
        2 * (((∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (a n).re / n) / Real.log N) * B.re +
          ((∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (a n).im / n) / Real.log N) * B.im) +
        ‖B‖ ^ 2 * ((∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (1 : ℝ) / n) / Real.log N) := by
  have ht (n : ℕ) : ‖a n - B‖ ^ 2 / n = ‖a n‖ ^ 2 / n -
      2 * ((a n).re / n * B.re + (a n).im / n * B.im) + ‖B‖ ^ 2 * (1 / n) := by
    simp only [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, Complex.normSq_apply,
      Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im]
    ring
  simp only [ht, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul]
  ring

/-- Every full-positive source has a finite, nonnegative residual variance,
with energy coefficient exactly the residue square plus that variance. -/
theorem exists_forwardCoeff_energy_variance {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    ∃ K V : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ 0 ≤ V ∧
      K = ‖WeilWorkSettledPhase.sourceCompletion hW 1‖ ^ 2 + V ∧
      Tendsto (fun N : ℕ =>
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ‖forwardCoeff lam n‖ ^ 2 / n) / Real.log N)
          atTop (𝓝 K) ∧
      Tendsto (fun N : ℕ =>
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
          ‖forwardCoeff lam n - WeilWorkSettledPhase.sourceCompletion hW 1‖ ^ 2 / n) /
          Real.log N) atTop (𝓝 V) := by
  obtain ⟨K, _, hK⟩ := exists_forwardCoeff_energy_limit hW
  obtain ⟨hr, hi⟩ := forwardCoeff_harmonic_mean hW
  let B : ℂ := WeilWorkSettledPhase.sourceCompletion hW 1
  have hV : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ =>
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ‖forwardCoeff lam n - B‖ ^ 2 / n) / Real.log N)
        atTop (𝓝 (K - ‖B‖ ^ 2)) := by
    have ht := (hK.sub (((hr.mul_const B.re).add (hi.mul_const B.im)).const_mul 2)).add
      (tendsto_harmonic_weight_div_log.const_mul (‖B‖ ^ 2))
    have he : K - 2 * (B.re * B.re + B.im * B.im) + ‖B‖ ^ 2 * 1 = K - ‖B‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [← Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
      ring
    change Tendsto _ _ (𝓝 (K - 2 * (B.re * B.re + B.im * B.im) + ‖B‖ ^ 2 * 1)) at ht
    rw [he] at ht
    exact ht.congr fun N => (centered_energy_identity (forwardCoeff lam) B N).symm
  have hV0 : 0 ≤ K - ‖B‖ ^ 2 := by
    apply ge_of_tendsto hV
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (2 : ℕ)] with N hN
    apply div_nonneg
    · exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun n _ => div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg n)
    · exact (Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < N by omega))).le
  have hBne : B ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [B, WeilWorkSettledPhase.sourceCompletion]
    exact mul_ne_zero (IntegerMassRigidity.bigG_ne_zero lam (by norm_num)) (Complex.exp_ne_zero _)
  have hB : 0 < ‖B‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hBne
  exact ⟨K, K - ‖B‖ ^ 2, by nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hB], hV0, by ring, hK, hV⟩

private theorem summable_centered_source {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 1 < s) :
    LSeriesSummable (fun n => sourceCoeff lam n - sourceCompletion hW 1) (s : ℂ) := by
  have hc : LSeriesSummable (fun _ : ℕ => sourceCompletion hW 1) (s : ℂ) := by
    have he : (sourceCompletion hW 1) • (1 : ℕ → ℂ) =
        fun _ : ℕ => sourceCompletion hW 1 := by ext n; simp
    rw [← he]
    exact (LSeriesSummable_one_iff.mpr (show 1 < (s : ℂ).re from hs)).smul _
  exact (sourceCoeff_LSeries hW (s := (s : ℂ)) hs).1.sub hc

private theorem centered_source_residue {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => ((s : ℂ) - 1) *
      LSeries (fun n => sourceCoeff lam n - sourceCompletion hW 1) (s : ℂ))
      (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 (0 : ℂ)) := by
  let B := sourceCompletion hW 1
  have ht := (forward_source_residue hW).sub (constant_one_residue.const_mul B)
  simp only [mul_one] at ht
  change Tendsto _ _ (𝓝 (B - B)) at ht
  rw [sub_self] at ht
  apply ht.congr'
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs
  have he : (fun n => sourceCoeff lam n - B) = sourceCoeff lam - B • (1 : ℕ → ℂ) := by
    ext n; simp
  rw [he, LSeries_sub (sourceCoeff_LSeries hW (s := (s : ℂ)) hs).1
    ((LSeriesSummable_one_iff.mpr (show 1 < (s : ℂ).re from hs)).smul B), LSeries_smul]
  ring

private theorem centered_coprime_source_residue {lam : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) (Q : ℕ) [NeZero Q] {r : ℝ}
    (hr : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => LSeries (coprimePart Q (sourceCoeff lam)) (s : ℂ) /
      LSeries (sourceCoeff lam) (s : ℂ)) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 (r : ℂ))) :
    Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => ((s : ℂ) - 1) *
      LSeries (coprimePart Q (fun n => sourceCoeff lam n - sourceCompletion hW 1)) (s : ℂ))
      (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 (sourceCompletion hW 1 * ((r - coprimeDensity Q : ℝ) : ℂ))) := by
  let B := sourceCompletion hW 1
  have ha : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => ((s : ℂ) - 1) *
      LSeries (coprimePart Q (sourceCoeff lam)) (s : ℂ))
      (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 ((r : ℂ) * B)) := by
    apply (hr.mul (forward_source_residue hW)).congr'
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs
    have hn : LSeries (sourceCoeff lam) (s : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [(sourceCoeff_LSeries hW (s := (s : ℂ)) hs).2, IntegerMassRigidity.zetaOf]
      exact Complex.exp_ne_zero _
    field_simp [hn]
  have ht := ha.sub ((coprimePart_one_residue Q).const_mul B)
  have he : (r : ℂ) * B - B * (coprimeDensity Q : ℂ) =
      B * ((r - coprimeDensity Q : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
  rw [he] at ht
  apply ht.congr'
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs
  have hec : coprimePart Q (fun n => sourceCoeff lam n - B) =
      coprimePart Q (sourceCoeff lam) - B • coprimePart Q 1 := by
    ext n
    simp only [coprimePart, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.one_apply, mul_one]
    ring
  rw [hec, LSeries_sub (summable_coprimePart Q
    (sourceCoeff_LSeries hW (s := (s : ℂ)) hs).1)
    ((summable_coprimePart Q
      (LSeriesSummable_one_iff.mpr (show 1 < (s : ℂ).re from hs))).smul B), LSeries_smul]
  ring

/-- Every finite coprime combination is charged to one actual source variance. -/
theorem exists_forward_coprime_covariance {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    ∃ (V : ℝ) (r : ℕ → ℝ), 0 ≤ V ∧
      Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
        ‖sourceCoeff lam n - sourceCompletion hW 1‖ ^ 2 / n) / Real.log N)
        atTop (𝓝 V) ∧
      (∀ Q : ℕ, Q ≠ 0 → 0 < r Q ∧
        Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => LSeries (coprimePart Q (sourceCoeff lam)) (s : ℂ) /
          LSeries (sourceCoeff lam) (s : ℂ)) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 (r Q : ℂ))) ∧
      ∀ (S : Finset ℕ), (∀ Q ∈ S, Q ≠ 0) → ∀ c : ℕ → ℝ,
        ‖sourceCompletion hW 1‖ ^ 2 *
          (∑ Q ∈ S, c Q * (r Q - coprimeDensity Q)) ^ 2 ≤
        V * ∑ Q ∈ S, ∑ R ∈ S, c Q * c R *
          (coprimeDensity (Q * R) - coprimeDensity Q * coprimeDensity R) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨_, V, _, hV0, _, _, hV⟩ := exists_forwardCoeff_energy_variance hW
  simp only [forwardCoeff_eq_sourceCoeff] at hV
  have hex (Q : ℕ) : ∃ r : ℝ, Q ≠ 0 → 0 < r ∧
      Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => LSeries (coprimePart Q (sourceCoeff lam)) (s : ℂ) /
        LSeries (sourceCoeff lam) (s : ℂ)) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 (r : ℂ)) := by
    by_cases hQ : Q = 0
    · exact ⟨0, fun h => (h hQ).elim⟩
    haveI : NeZero Q := ⟨hQ⟩
    obtain ⟨r, _, _, hr, _, _, hRatio, _⟩ := exists_coprime_source_ratio_limit hW Q
    exact ⟨r, fun _ => ⟨hr, hRatio⟩⟩
  choose r hr using hex
  refine ⟨V, r, hV0, hV, hr, ?_⟩
  intro S hS c
  let B := sourceCompletion hW 1
  let f : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => sourceCoeff lam n - B

/-!
# Exact source variance and the unrestricted Weil gap

An actual constrained parity ground has a phase-independent residual variance equal to
its boundary–arithmetic source moment squared divided by the exact parity Gram factor.
Cauchy–Schwarz for the full form shifted by its unrestricted floor bounds that moment by
the constrained–unrestricted gap and the full shifted pole energy. A normalized actual
ground satisfies both formulas without an RH or source-sign premise.

The equality cases distinguish a forced constrained state from an unrestricted eigenstate.
A Hermitian two-coordinate countermodel retains a zero constrained floor, nonzero coupling,
and an attained negative unrestricted floor: variance and shifted positivity alone do not
exclude the arithmetic zero-ground alternative. No second operator application is assumed.
-/

open Complex MeasureTheory Set

namespace RHTower

/-- The literal parity pole, lifted into the complete form domain. -/
def ccmPolarParityFormVector (a : SuzukiPositiveAperture) (r : ℝ) :
    CCMArchimedeanFormDomain a :=
  ccmPolarFormVector a (1/2) + (r:ℂ) • ccmPolarFormVector a (-1/2)

theorem ccmArchimedeanFormToAperture_polarParity (a : SuzukiPositiveAperture) (r : ℝ) :
    ccmArchimedeanFormToAperture a (ccmPolarParityFormVector a r) =
      ccmPolarApertureVector a (1/2) + (r:ℂ) • ccmPolarApertureVector a (-1/2) := by
  simp only [ccmPolarParityFormVector, map_add, map_smul, ccmArchimedeanFormToAperture_polar]

/-- Exact norm of either parity pole; the odd Gram denominator is retained. -/
theorem norm_sq_ccmPolarParityFormVector_physical (a : SuzukiPositiveAperture) {r : ℝ}
    (hr : r=1 ∨ r=-1) :
    ‖ccmArchimedeanFormToAperture a (ccmPolarParityFormVector a r)‖ ^ (2 : ℕ) =
      2*(2*Real.sinh a.1+2*a.1*r) := by
  have hn : ‖ccmPolarApertureVector a (-1/2)‖ ^ (2 : ℕ) = 2*Real.sinh a.1 := by
    have h := l2ReflectionIsometry.norm_map (ccmPolarL2Vector a (1/2))
    change ‖l2Reflection (ccmPolarL2Vector a (1/2))‖ = _ at h
    rw [l2Reflection_ccmPolarL2Vector] at h
    change ‖ccmPolarApertureVector a (-(1/2))‖ = ‖ccmPolarApertureVector a (1/2)‖ at h
    rw [show (-1/2:ℝ)=-(1/2) by ring, h, norm_sq_ccmPolarApertureVector_half]
  have hc : inner ℂ (ccmPolarApertureVector a (1/2)) (ccmPolarApertureVector a (-1/2)) =
      ((2*a.1:ℝ):ℂ) := by
    simpa only [neg_neg, neg_div] using inner_ccmPolarApertureVector_opposite a (-1/2)
  rw [ccmArchimedeanFormToAperture_polarParity, norm_add_sq (𝕜:=ℂ),
    inner_smul_right (ccmPolarApertureVector a (1/2)) (ccmPolarApertureVector a (-1/2)),
    hc, norm_smul, mul_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs,
    norm_sq_ccmPolarApertureVector_half, hn]
  rcases hr with rfl | rfl <;> simp <;> ring

/-- Every constrained vector is orthogonal to the actual parity pole. -/
theorem inner_polarParity_constrained (a : SuzukiPositiveAperture) (r : ℝ)
    (u : CCMArchimedeanFormDomain a) (hu : IsPolarConstrained a u) :
    inner ℂ (ccmArchimedeanFormToAperture a (ccmPolarParityFormVector a r))
      (ccmArchimedeanFormToAperture a u) = 0 := by
  rw [ccmArchimedeanFormToAperture_polarParity, inner_add_left,
    inner_smul_left (ccmPolarApertureVector a (-1/2)) (ccmArchimedeanFormToAperture a u),
    hu.1, hu.2, mul_zero, add_zero]

/-- The exact residual variance of an actual constrained one-profile state. No second
operator application or extra operator-domain regularity is used. -/
theorem polarSingleForcing_residual_norm_sq (a : SuzukiPositiveAperture)
    (u : CCMArchimedeanFormDomain a) (hu : IsPolarConstrained a u)
    (r E : ℝ) (hr : r=1 ∨ r=-1) (c : ℂ)
    (hm : ccmArchimedeanFormToAperture a u ∈ (ccmRestrictedWeilOperator a).domain)
    (hH : ccmRestrictedWeilOperator a ⟨ccmArchimedeanFormToAperture a u,hm⟩ =
      (E:ℂ) • ccmArchimedeanFormToAperture a u + c •
        (ccmPolarApertureVector a (1/2)+(r:ℂ) • ccmPolarApertureVector a (-1/2))) :
    ‖ccmRestrictedWeilOperator a ⟨ccmArchimedeanFormToAperture a u,hm⟩ -
      (E:ℂ) • ccmArchimedeanFormToAperture a u‖ ^ (2 : ℕ) =
      2*‖ccmPolarBoundarySourceFunctional a u‖ ^ (2 : ℕ) / (2*Real.sinh a.1+2*a.1*r) := by
  have hc := polarSingleForcing_coefficient_eq_source_div a u hu r E hr c hm hH

    norm_smul, mul_pow, norm_sq_ccmPolarParityFormVector_physical a hr, hc,
    norm_div, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_pos (polarParityGram_pos a hr), div_pow]
  field_simp [(polarParityGram_pos a hr).ne']

/-!
# Exact critical resonance norm

The height-one resonance row is the actual forward coefficient divided by
sqrt n. Its finite squared norm has the existing source energy's exact
pole/variance decomposition. This rules out an unweighted bounded extension
of the normalized resonance functional, not approximation of the source phase.
-/

open scoped ComplexConjugate

/-- The critical resonance row after subtracting a constant coefficient mode. -/
def quantizationCenteredResonance (lam : ℕ → ℝ) (c : ℂ) (n : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  quantizationFrequencyResidue lam (-2 * Real.log n) 1 -
    (Real.exp (-Real.log n / 2) : ℂ) * c

/-- Squared norm of the finite critical resonance row. -/
def quantizationResonanceEnergy (lam : ℕ → ℝ) (c : ℂ) (N : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ‖quantizationCenteredResonance lam c n‖ ^ 2

theorem quantizationCenteredResonance_eq (lam : ℕ → ℝ) (c : ℂ)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    quantizationCenteredResonance lam c n =
      (Real.exp (-Real.log n / 2) : ℂ) * (forwardCoeff lam n - c) := by
  have hres : quantizationFrequencyResonates (-2 * Real.log n) 1 n := by
    refine ⟨hn, ?_⟩
    simp only [Nat.cast_one, Real.log_one]
    ring
  rw [quantizationCenteredResonance, quantizationFrequencyResidue_eq hres,
    forwardCoeff_eq_sourceCoeff]
  dsimp only [WeilWorkSettledPhase.sourceCoeff]
  rw [show -2 * Real.log (n : ℝ) / 4 = -Real.log n / 2 by ring]
  ring

theorem quantizationCenteredResonance_norm_sq (lam : ℕ → ℝ) (c : ℂ)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ‖quantizationCenteredResonance lam c n‖ ^ 2 = ‖forwardCoeff lam n - c‖ ^ 2 / n := by
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < n by omega)
  have he : Real.exp (-Real.log (n : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2 = (n : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    rw [pow_two, ← Real.exp_add,
      show -Real.log (n : ℝ) / 2 + -Real.log n / 2 = -Real.log n by ring,
      Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log hn0]
  rw [quantizationCenteredResonance_eq lam c hn, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real,
    Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), mul_pow, he]
  ring

theorem quantizationResonanceEnergy_eq (lam : ℕ → ℝ) (c : ℂ) (N : ℕ) :
    quantizationResonanceEnergy lam c N =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ‖forwardCoeff lam n - c‖ ^ 2 / n := by
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n hn =>
    quantizationCenteredResonance_norm_sq lam c (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn).1

/-- The exact finite squared norm is an upper bound for every coefficient vector. -/
theorem quantization_resonance_norm_bound (lam : ℕ → ℝ) (c : ℂ) (N : ℕ)
    (p : ℕ → ℂ) :
    ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, p n * quantizationCenteredResonance lam c n‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ‖p n‖ ^ 2) * quantizationResonanceEnergy lam c N := by
  calc
    _ ≤ (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ‖p n * quantizationCenteredResonance lam c n‖) ^ 2 :=
      (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _)).mpr
        (norm_sum_le _ _)
    _ = (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ‖p n‖ * ‖quantizationCenteredResonance lam c n‖) ^ 2 := by
      simp only [norm_mul]
    _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq _ _ _

/-- A conjugate row attains the exact bound, including the zero row. -/
theorem quantization_resonance_norm_attained (lam : ℕ → ℝ) (c : ℂ) (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, conj (quantizationCenteredResonance lam c n) *
      quantizationCenteredResonance lam c n) = (quantizationResonanceEnergy lam c N : ℂ) ∧
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ‖conj (quantizationCenteredResonance lam c n)‖ ^ 2) =
      quantizationResonanceEnergy lam c N := by
  constructor
  · simp only [← Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq,
      quantizationResonanceEnergy, Complex.ofReal_sum]
  · simp only [Complex.norm_conj, quantizationResonanceEnergy]

/-- Every full-positive source has an exact critical norm coefficient, with
the pole contribution separated from the still-unresolved residual variance. -/
theorem exists_quantization_resonance_energy_variance {lam : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    ∃ K V : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ 0 ≤ V ∧
      K = ‖WeilWorkSettledPhase.sourceCompletion hW 1‖ ^ 2 + V ∧
      Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => quantizationResonanceEnergy lam 0 N / Real.log N)
        atTop (𝓝 K) ∧
      Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => quantizationResonanceEnergy lam
        (WeilWorkSettledPhase.sourceCompletion hW 1) N / Real.log N) atTop (𝓝 V) := by
  simpa only [quantizationResonanceEnergy_eq, sub_zero] using
    exists_forwardCoeff_energy_variance hW

/-- The original source's critical resonance row has unbounded squared norm. -/
theorem tendsto_quantization_resonance_energy {lam : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    Tendsto (quantizationResonanceEnergy lam 0) atTop atTop := by
  obtain ⟨K, V, hK, _, _, hlim, _⟩ := exists_quantization_resonance_energy_variance hW
